# Response to the v0.1.0 critical review

**Note:** This file was generated by ChatGPT 5.6 Sol under the direction of Adam Phillippy.

This record maps every numbered finding to the maintained implementation. It records
decisions rather than reproducing the review, preventing current documentation from
drifting back toward superseded candidates.

| Finding | Disposition | Maintained evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| P1-1 | Implemented | Browser production and statistical tests share validated `ScientificConfig`; every tile carries its digest. |
| P1-2 | Implemented | `ExactKmerSet` stores collision-free canonical two-bit k-mers and is the sole scientific oracle. |
| P1-3 | Implemented | A serialized worker queue parses into a staging session and commits only the current generation. |
| P1-4 | Implemented | Initially terminal domains bypass sketches and request exact k-mer tiles immediately. |
| P1-5 | Implemented | `FrozenAxis`, preallocation admission, prepared/zoom budgets, and a 1.5 GiB Wasm-session ceiling bound retained core state. |
| P2-1 | Implemented | Wasm tile channels are consuming; worker-side array copies were removed. |
| P2-2 | Superseded | An incremental BED/GFF/GTF implementation was completed, then removed before the v0.2 beta at maintainer direction because feature import did not meet the release reliability bar. |
| P2-3 | Implemented | Real-Wasm Playwright tests cover transaction races, exact entry, privacy, keyboard input, context restoration, progressive refinement, and worker recovery. |
| P2-4 | Implemented in tooling | Toolchains/actions are pinned; one atomic build generates Wasm/UI/docs/SBOM/licenses; clean source and binary packaging records checksums and provenance. External publication is intentionally outside this local release cycle. |
| P2-5 | Implemented | Scientific positional switches were replaced at public construction boundaries by an immutable, versioned, validated configuration. |
| P2-6 | Implemented | Phase 0, minmer/bottom-s, alternate hash, densification, inverted matrix, and legacy base kernels were removed after tagging `v0.1.0`. |
| P3-1 | Implemented | Stable methods, generated current parameters, validation status, provenance, and historical decisions have separate owners; documentation checks verify the standard note and local links. |
| P3-2 | Implemented | U/u-to-T/t normalization and all accepted ambiguity/gap/comment/whitespace behavior are normative and tested. |
| ALG-1 | Adopted after validation | Verified matches divided by union-occupied registers reduced error/bias and is now the production estimator. The sweep reports matrix-wide 32-bit/full-winner discrepancies. |
| ALG-2 | Adopted after validation | HLL p10 is the default; p8–p12 are covered by the controlled sweep. |
| ALG-3 | Adopted | Quick blocks paint first. Default detailed work is limited to tiles near display decisions or with weak support; high-sensitivity mode refines the complete request. |
| ALG-4, fused build | Benchmarked, not adopted | Exact 2,048-to-256 projection reduced final time but delayed first preview from 139 ms to 533 ms, conflicting with the interaction-first objective. Separate builds remain. |
| ALG-4, scheduling/direction | Adopted | X/Y preparation interleaves and publishes compatible blocks before full axes exist. Both directed evidence sets are pooled; support controls chroma, not identity. |
| ALG-5 | Validation framework implemented | The bounded sweep uses production seed zero plus independent validation layouts and exact containment. It reports 80/85/90/95 confusion, holes, isolated pixels, line continuity, local error, error autocorrelation, feature-rank overlap, and component stability. Broader biological validation remains explicitly preregistered work. |

Additional recommendations are also implemented: capability detection, keyboard and
textual canvas access, allocation validation, context restoration from retained numeric
tiles, restrictive CSP, total-memory reporting, and bounded cache eviction. Axis-cache
recency changed from linear scans to indexed logarithmic operations; a more complex
intrusive O(1) list is intentionally deferred unless profiling shows this small cache's
logarithmic bookkeeping is material.

The normative current method is [SCIENTIFIC_SPEC.md](../SCIENTIFIC_SPEC.md). Architecture
and scheduling are in [DESIGN.md](../DESIGN.md), current evidence and remaining claims
are in [STATUS.md](../STATUS.md), and the accepted decision is
[ADR 0004](../adr/0004-validated-production-backend.md).
